title: The Milky Way is not really an arch
description:
A wide-angle lens makes the Milky Way look like an arch. The photographer framed it to match a dark lagoon, so it looks like a cosmic eye.
NASA picture: GSFC, GSFC_20171208_Archive_e000261. NASA/CXC/M.Weiss/Ohio State/A Gupta et al. It is an artist’s drawing of the Milky Way.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Ignacio Fernández: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-26-eye-in-the-sky-the-milky-way-over-lencois/. To use it, please ask the owner.
